The

visualize

Fish

were
anesthetized
in
ice - water
before
being
fixed
in
4 %
formaldehyde
for
2
hours .
Fixed

fish
were
injected
with
Dil
using
microelectrodes
approximately
1
um
in
diameter

from
1.5
mm
capillary
tubes .
Fish
were
injected
2
to
5
times
in

ventral
musculature
and

stored
overnight
in
a
4 ° C
fridge .
The
days
2
through
5
fish

stored

distilled
water

until
we
noticed
that

of
the
distilled
water
differed

the
fish
and

was
reducing
the
number

successful
injections .
